title: The Glass Bridge
text: A bridge of clear glass spans a gorge, so clear you only know it is there by the dust on it. Below, far below, a city lies in the valley, lamps lit, streets full, a city you have never heard of. Its people are all looking up.

options.label: Cross carefully over the city, and do not meet the eyes looking up.

outcomes.text: It holds, and the city's people watch every step, and none of them blink.
It cracks under the heaviest, and the people below cheer.

options.label: Run across together, before the glass can think better of holding you.

outcomes.text: Fast, and the cracks only start behind you.

options.label: The wisest studies the city below, though it looks back.

outcomes.text: It is a city from the time before the rift, and it is not empty, and they are waiting for someone to fall.
